content_blocks.heading_text: Project Management Careers in Marietta's Aerospace Hub
content_blocks.text:
Marietta's economy centers on aerospace and defense manufacturing, with Lockheed Martin's aeronautics plant driving sustained demand for certified project managers across the region. The company's ongoing production of C-130J and F-35 components, along with facility upgrades, requires skilled PMs to coordinate complex schedules and technical workflows. Beyond aerospace, WellStar Health System—a major regional employer—relies on certified project managers to oversee capital improvement projects and facility expansions, including work at WellStar Kennestone Regional Medical Center. Cobb County Government and the Cobb County School District also maintain steady hiring for project professionals, while infrastructure initiatives like the Marietta Square downtown redevelopment demonstrate the breadth of local project activity across public and private sectors.

The PMP credential carries particular weight in Marietta's aerospace, defense, and healthcare sectors, where structured project management practices are essential to regulatory compliance and operational success. Project managers with PMP certification and industry-specific experience typically command competitive compensation in the Atlanta metro market, with aerospace and healthcare roles offering especially strong pay due to their specialized technical demands. Completing Granite PM Academy's PMP Boot Camp positions you to advance into these higher-demand roles and establish yourself as a credible, standards-trained professional in a market where major employers actively seek certified talent. Whether you're building from entry-level through CAPM or advancing your career with full PMP credentials, the Marietta market rewards certification with opportunity and earning potential.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Marietta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour thresholds based on your degree level. Granite PM Academy's advisors can assess your background and confirm readiness before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Marietta-focused cohorts deliver PMI-mandated formal education in an interactive format. You'll cover all five process groups and ten knowledge areas required by the Project Management Institute.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP application with the Project Management Institute and remit the examination fee. Our team guides you through the online portal and documentation process. PMI may audit your credentials; Granite PM Academy provides support if questions arise.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a Marietta-area testing center or via remote proctoring. Our instructors remain available to address final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across PMI's three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing webinars, workshops, and recertification-focused courses to support your continued learning and credential maintenance.
